Campus Laddering - Maximal laddering sets for Elite climbers (8A+/V12 & up)

The goal of this workout is to increase strength and power in the upper body and arms.  It is designed for Elite climbers (8A+/V12) and with prior campus experience.

Use the smallest rung size possible whilst still completing the prescribed sets.  Complete the following campus movements.  Start each set matched on the first numbered rung and finish each set matched on the last numbered rung.

All odd sets start with left hand first. All even sets start with right hand first.

Sets 1 to 6: 1-4-7
Sets 7 to 12: 1-5-8

If these movements are not maximal, complete 1-5-9 for sets 7 to 12.
